original.title: The Constitution of Society. Outline of the Theory of Structuration
original.note: OpenAlex record that collects the book's citations (typed as article).

core_idea: Structure and agency make each other. When people act they draw on rules and resources (structure), and by acting they reproduce or change those same rules and resources. Giddens calls this the duality of structure: structure is both the medium and the outcome of action.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How are routines, rules or practices in an organization reproduced or changed over time?
How does the way people use a technology reshape the organization around it?
Longitudinal qualitative designs: observation, repeated interviews, case studies that follow practices over time.
common_mistakes: Using 'duality of structure' as a label without showing the loop in the data: which rules and resources people drew on, and what their actions reproduced or changed.
Trying to measure 'structure' as a variable. In Giddens's sense structure exists only when people draw on it.
Expecting a ready-made method. Giddens gave few methodological guidelines; you will need to borrow one.
